label: NAR derivation: laws, nonvacuity, the mixed-mode root, omission models
paraphrase: Premise-free laws and finite models (structural surrogates, not metaphysical possibility). Laws: (1) a two-way giver is one two-way toward some effect; (2) with (b), factive giving, a common root, necessary roots and some concrete contingent being, every actual root is two-way toward some concrete contingent being; (3) with these and excluded middle, NAR holds exactly when (a) does; (4) exercise-level invariance with exercise as giving makes a giver two-way toward nothing (uniformity only by collapse); (5) with reflexive access, the will route gives (a) without (b). Models: theist nonvacuity of N1-N3; the mixed-mode root (one rational power, invariant set-up, willed two-way giving toward the contingent, fixed giving toward a necessary grounded being that holds the joint-absence power; (b) and the holder premises hold; uniformity, (a), NAR and #1944's argument 1 conclusion fail; WN or SS fails); omission models of N1, N2 and N3.
